basis: user explicitly authorized bounded H-chain input/reference preparation, 2026-10-04

determinant_helpers.load: only four hash-verified pure function ASTs, never historical imports/top-level code

H6_generation.geometry: linear H6 z_i=i-2.5 Angstrom, STO-3G, neutral singlet
H6_generation.orbitals: canonical RHF, conv_tol=1e-12, max_cycle=200, no core, six active spatial orbitals
H6_generation.grouping: unchanged Almost_optimal_grouper, validation=True, Jordan-Wigner, archived group structure and K must match
H6_generation.population_sector: alpha=beta=3, ascending MSB full indices, dimension 400; no ground-derived Z2 restriction
H6_generation.state: RHF determinant plus singles/doubles, lowest subspace eigenvector, embedded into population sector
H6_generation.new_state_phase: largest magnitude component real positive, no exact-state alignment
H6_generation.Hamiltonian_identity: new coefficient snapshot explicitly authorized; freeze bytes and array/term/group identities, not numerically-equivalent historical cache reuse

reference.fit: unchanged hash-verified leading_fit AST and inherited rolling_loglog_fits

barrier.input_freeze: six lightweight input artifacts committed before H2/H6 grid acquisition
barrier.mixed_archives: whole-file hash allowed; only named Hamiltonian/group/CISD members deserialized; no exact/ground/D4/D6/D8 member reads
barrier.tests: new truth-free unit tests only; no legacy truth-reading/full review_tests before later candidate prediction freeze
barrier.failure: stop with separate failure audit, no alternative grid/state/grouping/subset/precision/retry rescue

success_meaning: input/coordinate/source/method readiness only; main candidate execution requires a new reviewed authorization
